{{Top|leg}}
'''Auxiliary pedals''' were mechanisms located under the control console of certain [[Starship/Legends|starships]], including the [[YT-1300 light freighter/Legends|YT-1300 light freighter]]. They were operated by the [[Pilot/Legends|pilot's]] feet, and were used to aim the [[Laser/Legends|batteries]] of the craft, especially the [[Quad laser cannon/Legends|quad-guns]]. The [[Millennium Falcon/Legends|''Millennium Falcon'']] incorporated a set of auxiliary pedals, when owned by [[Lando Calrissian/Legends|Lando Calrissian]] around [[3 BBY/Legends|3 BBY]].
